label: Consequence
text: PL.O.A3.2 Consequence. Deduction preserves truth if valid. Induction does not, and can still be reasonable. Abduction infers to an explanation. Validity is form; soundness adds true premises.

warrant.warrant: W1 (in a stated system, uses MA.O.A1); W9 (which logic)
warrant.standard: Proof in a stated system; fit to practice
